title: Each Grothendieck covering sieve has the stage-image sheaf condition
statement: Under the same hypotheses as the stage-image sheaf theorem, for every object Y and sieve S in Q.toGrothendieck Y, the presieve S.arrows satisfies IsSheafFor for the stage-image subpresheaf.
